prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1242; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the left rear quarter panel and rear door shows crumpling and paint transfer consistent with a side impact at an intersection. Structural measurements taken at the rear wheel well and sill were checked against factory specifications and no misalignment outside tolerance was found. The proposed plan calls for replacing the rear door shell, repairing the quarter panel, and refinishing both areas. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this work. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account, and the shop's invoices show no repeated charges for the same parts or operations.
